welcome.title: Welcome to Talent Catcher
welcome.body: A quick tour through the most important areas — you can restart it anytime via "Getting-Started Tour" in the bottom left.

hero.title: Action items at a glance
hero.body: Here you can see immediately whether — and how many — talents need attention right now, automatically calculated by the risk engine.

urgent.title: Most urgent action items
urgent.body: The talents with the highest risk appear at the top here, including alert status and reasoning.

watchlists-section.title: My watchlists
watchlists-section.body: Your own talent groupings, e.g. for a specific scouting day or age group.

nav-talente.title: Talents
nav-talente.body: The complete talent list with filters for position, status, and alert — this is also where you create new talents.

talents-filters.title: Filter by selection & development programs
talents-filters.body: In addition to position, contract status, and alert, you can filter the list by DFB talent center, regional select team, national team, NLZ status, and EU passport.

talent-detail.title: On the talent detail page
talent-detail.body: Update club and team, link a Transfermarkt/FuPa profile, upload video highlights, document injuries, note talented siblings — and more. To keep things clear with so much detail, the sections below the overview are collapsible: tap to expand or collapse.

nav-alerts.title: Alerts & Follow-ups
nav-alerts.body: All open action items in one place — automatic alerts and follow-ups you've set yourself.

nav-watchlists.title: Watchlists
nav-watchlists.body: An overview of all your watchlists with talent counts.

nav-import.title: Import
nav-import.body: Import existing scouting lists via CSV or XLSX, including column mapping.

nav-abo.title: Subscription
nav-abo.body: Your current plan and trial period — after the free trial ends, you'll choose a subscription here.

nav-verwaltung.title: Administration
nav-verwaltung.body: Edit the club name, assign the club to a regional football association, manage team members (role, youth protection access, deactivate) and invite new scouts by email.

finish.title: Ready to get started
finish.body: That's it! You can restart the tour anytime via "Getting-Started Tour" in the bottom left of the sidebar.

scoutReportForm.reminderNotice: This report automatically completes the associated follow-up.
scoutReportForm.mainScaleHint: Main rating scale 1–5: 1 = very weak, 5 = very strong.
scoutReportForm.tinderCriteriaHint: Additional assessment scales from 1 to 4: 1 = barely present, 4 = strongly present. These do not affect the overall rating (which remains the average of technique/tactics/athleticism/mentality), but do feed — together with potential and maturity level — into the automatic risk assessment, e.g. as an additional hidden-gem signal.
scoutReportForm.potenzialHint: General potential scale, separate from the current performance rating.
scoutReportForm.reifegradHint: Biological maturity relative to chronological age.
scoutReportForm.overrideReasonPlaceholder: e.g. a standout moment outshines overall performance

talentDetailPage.noRiskAssessment: No risk assessment available yet (will appear after the first recalculation).
talentDetailPage.isMinorHint: Determined automatically from the date of birth.
talentDetailPage.siblingsHint: A private note for yourself — e.g. when scouting reveals that there's a talented brother or sister as well. This does not create a separate talent profile; use the "Register as talent" link below for that.
talentDetailPage.siblingNotePlaceholder: e.g. also plays for us in the U15
talentDetailPage.upcomingTransferHint: A private note for yourself — e.g. to know that reaching out isn't worthwhile right now. No brokering, no contact with third parties.
talentDetailPage.transferNotePlaceholder: e.g. likely from summer 2027, coach says it's already agreed
talentDetailPage.guardianAccessHint: Invites the parent or guardian to their own restricted access: maintain club/team (e.g. for a transfer you would otherwise not hear about) and upload/view videos. No access to reports, tags, or the risk assessment.
talentDetailPage.externalProfilesHint: Only a link to the respective profile — for legal reasons (providers' terms of use), no embedded data.
talentDetailPage.noReports: No reports yet — the first report will establish the baseline rating.
talentDetailPage.noConsentUpload: There is no documented consent for video material for this minor talent yet — upload is therefore locked.
talentDetailPage.grantConsentHint: Only record this once valid consent from the parent or guardian actually exists (e.g. a signed form). This app only stores the record of consent, not the document itself.
talentDetailPage.consentNotePlaceholder: e.g. signed form is on file at the club office
talentDetailPage.consentConfirm: I confirm that valid consent from the parent or guardian for video material exists.
talentDetailPage.consentNeedsAccess: Only a team member with youth protection access can grant consent.
talentDetailPage.injuriesHint: Injury history as an observation note — deliberately not factored automatically into the risk assessment.
talentDetailPage.injuryNotePlaceholder: e.g. still in rehab training according to the coach
